newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan call rates jump to 20 pct on cash crunch.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan call rates jump to 20 pct on cash crunch.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank call market rates soared to 20 percent on Wednesday from 13 percent on Tuesday due to a liquidity crunch, dealers said.

Liquidity tightened after open market operations by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan on Tuesday and Wednesday at a cutoff yield of 16.5 percent, 150 basis points above the cutoff at the last auction, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Rates were likely to open high on Thursday, the dealer said.
